# Internal Affairs
## The Magistrate is to:
1. Hold court hearings and trials in accordance with NTCLP Article 5.
2. Ensure that hearings and trials are fast and efficient, but still as thorough as necessary. - a. The Magistrate is to ensure that time and resources are not spent on frivolous cases, and that the type of proceeding is held in accordance with severity and importance. - b. The Magistrate is to ensure that court proceedings do not unduly impact station productivity.
3. Communicate with the Executive Officer regarding major court decisions.
## Internal Affairs Agents are to:
1. Prioritize answering court summons and requests for representation above other duties. - a. Internal Affairs Agents are to represent the side of NanoTrasen in court, whether it be prosecution or defense.
2. Ensure Standard Operating Procedure is being properly followed. - a. Internal Affairs Agents are to issue a fine for violations of Standard Operating Procedure. - b. Internal Affairs Agents are to notify the appropriate head of staff for major violations of Standard Operating Procedure. They are additionally to log such violations in a Major SOP Violation Form (IAB-01) and submit a copy of it to the Executive Officer.
3. Work together to complete a Department Review Form (IAB-02) concerning each department other than Command and Internal Affairs. - a. These reports are to be presented to the Executive Officer by the end of the shift. - b. This requirement applies to all Internal Affairs Agents collectively. Only one report per department needs to be made between all of them.
